m1.crumb: Masters · the staff record every calculation reads from
m1.anno: FRS §7.10 (FR-14) and §12.3.1 (Interface Requirements). PAY_EMP_MAST — ~166 attributes, effective-dated (§27). There is no manual "Add Employee" action on this screen. A new employee record is created automatically when HRMS sends it through INTF_PAY_EMP_BOB (cyclic/event-based interface, §12.3.1) — that populates every H field (EIS No., Name, PAN, DOB, Joining Date, Bank). The record then shows here with status "Payroll Setup Pending" until Establishment/HR completes the E fields (Pay Pattern, Pay Scale, Basic, City) via Edit Record — CPF Code is system-generated at the parent zone for IDA and enterable only for CDA (§8.3) — only then is the employee eligible for payroll computation. The marker on every field is the ownership answer of §6.2.2: H read-only here, E enterable, R from the rule engine. OQ-7 — FCI must confirm this split per attribute.

i10.crumb: Masters · staff transfer between organisational units, and the confirmed staff-number reissue mechanism
i10.anno: FRS §8.10.1 — this is FRS §32.2's M-11, the sole authoritative screen for this function. (Corrected at pack v4.7: this screen previously carried the wrong code, I-10, while an unrelated screen — Statutory Output Definitions — wrongly occupied M-11; that screen has been renumbered to M-17. See R-18 for the full reconciliation note.) OQ-46 withdrawn in FRS v0.5 is resolved — FCI confirmed during the FRS walkthrough that the staff number (EMP_NUM/EIS number) IS reissued at the destination region on inter-region transfer, consistent with legacy system behaviour. PAN is now specified as the permanent, person-level identity anchor (§8.6) that never changes across a transfer — the staff number is a region-scoped, reissuable attribute held under that PAN. The new CPF/EPS Member ID (§15.3) and the new staff number are issued together, on the same effective-dated transfer event.

c2.crumb: Calculation · IDA and CDA pay patterns of the single staff engine
c2.anno: FRS §8 (FR-01). IDA and CDA are pay patterns of one engine, not two payroll types (§3.2) — they share the component catalogue, screens and computation package. Every money column is calculated; the trace shows which master field, input or rule produced it. OQ-1 — canonical PL/SQL package version.

rbac.note: No direct edit of a locked result under any role, including Administrator. A number changes one of two ways: correct an input or a rule and re-run, or raise a §7.12.2 override request — Maker states a reason, Checker approves, the system unlocks that record only, applies the adjustment and re-locks it.
